title: Beast of Reincarnation
summary: Unreal Engine 5 titles that crash on the first cutscene. The carrier sits under a compiler-named subfolder, which the script discovers rather than assumes.

excerpts.note: Electra asks the H.264 decoder for the types it can output; CrossOver's offers no NV12, so the fix puts NV12 back in the list.
Sets Electra.Win.H264UseOldOutputPath, found by its own name rather than by an address, so Electra takes its CPU buffer path and never the D3D one.

cause: Electra plays the H.264 video through a Media Foundation decoder that offers no NV12 on CrossOver, so the picture never reaches the screen.
